concerns.text: FR-006 (Memory Management) and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) require a defined project structure and pinned dependencies. Task T001 (Create project structure) is marked unchecked [ ], meaning the foundational infrastructure required to run the pipeline on a fresh runner is not covered by a task.

Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Plan 'Technical Context' require linting (ruff) and formatting (black) configuration. Task T003 (Configure linting) is marked unchecked [ ], leaving the code quality and reproducibility constraints unimplemented.

FR-006 (Memory) and Edge Cases (download failures) require robust error handling. Tasks T008.1 (FAIL LOUDLY logging) and T008.2 (Exponential backoff) are marked unchecked [ ]. While T015 references T008.2, the implementation of the backoff logic itself is not covered by a completed task.

Plan Phase 1.1 requires stratified sampling by 'action type'. Tasks T012.0.1 (Define sampling strategy), T012.0.2 (Generate sample list), and T012.0.4 (Verify class balance) are marked unchecked [ ]. Without these, the data diversity requirement for US1 is not covered.

FR-001 requires downloading the LingBot-Video model. Task T012.0.3 (Download LingBot-Video weights) is marked unchecked [ ]. The extraction pipeline (T012.1) depends on this, leaving the core data acquisition unimplemented.

FR-002 requires extracting latent vectors and expert masks. Task T013 (Implement torch.no_grad() inference) is marked unchecked [ ] and explicitly flagged in the Analyze report as 'FAILED: unspecified'. The core feature extraction logic is missing.
FR-002 and Plan Phase 1.3 require saving extracted features to `data/processed/features.npy`. Task T016 (Save extracted features) is marked unchecked [ ]. The output artifact for US1 is not covered.

Plan Phase 0.3 and SC-004 require logging memory usage to verify the 7GB limit. Task T017 (Add logging for memory usage) is marked unchecked [ ]. The verification of the memory constraint is not covered.

FR-003 and Plan Phase 2.1/2.2 require 3D reconstruction and kinematic consistency checks. Tasks T021.1 (Reconstruct 3D) and T021.2 (Kinematic Check) are marked unchecked [ ]. The ground-truth labeling pipeline is incomplete.

Plan Phase 2.4 requires applying synthetic perturbations to create 'invalid' labels. Task T023.1 (Assign labels with perturbation logic) is marked unchecked [ ]. The mechanism for generating the 'invalid' class is not covered.

FR-008 and Plan Phase 2.5 require filtering low-confidence samples and assigning 'null' labels. Task T024 (Implement labeling step for nulls) is marked unchecked [ ]. The data hygiene requirement for noisy labels is not covered.
Plan Phase 4.1 requires verifying physical validity balance before training. Task T012.0.5 (Verify physical validity balance) is marked unchecked [ ]. The prerequisite for US3 is not covered.
SC-001 requires calculating a baseline distribution (Majority Class Predictor). Task T032.1 (Compute baseline distribution) is marked unchecked [ ]. The evaluation metric baseline is not covered.

FR-007 and SC-002 require feature importance analysis (SHAP). Task T033 (Implement feature importance analysis) is marked unchecked [ ]. The requirement to identify predictive sub-networks is not covered.
Plan Phase 4.6 requires generating visualizations and saving metrics. Task T035 (Generate visualization and save metrics) is marked unchecked [ ]. The final reporting artifacts are not covered.

Constitution Principle VI and SC-005 require a Latent-Space Independence Audit. Tasks T036.3.1 (Implement audit) and T036.3.2 (Generate audit report) are marked unchecked [ ]. The critical independence verification is not covered.

Constitution Principle V and Plan Phase 5.1 require updating `state/manifest.yaml` with artifact hashes. Task T036 (Update manifest hashes) is marked unchecked [ ]. The versioning and reproducibility requirement is not covered.
FR-007 requires an 'Associational Framing' section in the results report. Task T037.1 (Generate results_report.md) is marked unchecked [ ]. The mandatory framing requirement is not covered.
Plan Phase 0.3 and SC-004 require verifying peak RAM < 7GB via optimization. Task T040 (Performance optimization) is marked unchecked [ ]. The memory constraint verification is not covered.

Task T013 contains a comment 'FAILED: unspecified' and is unchecked. While the task exists, the description implies a previous failure state that needs resolution or removal to avoid confusion, though the primary issue is the lack of implementation (requirement).
